enrichment.core_claim: Neuroimaging trials show mindfulness and psilocybin act on pain and self networks through complementary routes, so combining them sustains benefits.
enrichment.ask_question: What does a mindfulness integration session look like after psilocybin dosing in your trials?
enrichment.challenge_question: Does weaker DMN thalamic connectivity at four weeks actually predict lasting pain relief, or is it an indirect marker?
